name: Bassella (Spain)
description: Light green field with a white wavy Y lying horizontally with its fork towards the fly, charged with a yellow castle at the hoist and two blue and white wavy roundels at the fly.
history: The official flag of Bassella is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, light green, with a white wavy Y of arms of thickness 1/12 of the height of the cloth, placed horizontally with the fork at a distance of 5/12 of the length from the hoist; approved on 27 February 2007 and published in the DOGC on 20 March 2007.

features.role: wavy pall (Y) lying horizontally, forking towards the fly
two roundels barry wavy of blue and white
